findings: Strong coherent rain, wet floor reflections, cyan/amber palette, typography and death/menu presentation.

Combat target silhouettes are small amid cover, while offscreen charging/recent-fire labels cluster; snapshot control made threat localization difficult.
Receiver distance alone is insufficient: ring placement prompt is explicit, but getting inside the ring under fire was difficult on second approach.
No obvious medical-table interaction prompt was seen; nearby kill drops visibly granted health/armor/ammunition. No claim of a broken medical pickup.
